correctness.rationale: Reconstructed digits, length and parity restrictions and exact carry count. Carries cannot decrease once started; their count fixes the unique transition. Gap h>=2 contradicts mirrored high column; gap h=0 excludes n>=3; gap h=1 yields unique alternating digits and excludes odd n. The formula constructs each even pair and the explicit U,V provide triple sums. Independently written exhaustive base3 enumerator verified all unordered pairs and triples through n=14. Finite checks are supplementary only.

value.rationale: Determines exact ternary additive antipalindromic length for an infinite natural radix-boundary family, shows the conjectured three-term ceiling is genuinely sharp infinitely often, and uniquely classifies every two-summand exception. The carry-budget rigidity is a structural method rather than a mere finite computation. No arbitrary sliced invariant is introduced.
